title: F09 · fathers_dream · Engineer
lines: My son will be an engineer. He says it to every customer.
"My son will be an engineer." He says it to every customer.
Kabir draws. He has never told him.
The coaching fee is one lakh forty thousand.
His father has already paid half.
How do you tell a man his dream is the wrong size for you?
An old customer was waiting for change. He picked up the sketchbook by mistake.
A father once did not recognise his own son. It took him losing the boy to look properly.
Papa looked at the drawing of his own shop.
Every tin. Every shelf. Exactly right.
He said: Show me the others.
Before you decide who they are, look. That is sadhana.
